title: Same AI. One Extra Skill.
script: Same AI. Same code change. One extra review skill. I seeded three reviewable issues: a missing permission check, an input edge case, and a keyboard trap. One session gets the usual request. The other also gets a short, focused review checklist. I scored useful findings, missed issues, and false alarms. More words do not earn more points. [CONTROL_FINDINGS] versus [SKILL_FINDINGS]. [FALSE_POSITIVE_RESULT]. [SCOPE_LIMITED_CONCLUSION]. Would you build a small skill library?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: A/B review of the same diff with and without a focused review skill.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: Same AI. Same code change. One extra review skill.
Does a review checklist change what the AI catches?
More review text does not mean more correct findings.
strongestHook: Same AI. Same code change. One extra review skill.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: A/B review of the same diff with and without a focused review skill. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Prepare a local review fixture with three known issues: missing permission check in a mock handler, empty-input edge case and keyboard-inaccessible control. Record baseline commit and expected findings before the runs. Use identical fresh model sessions and prompt, with only the second receiving a focused review checklist. Blind-score validated findings, misses and false alarms; keep useful unseeded findings separate. No superiority claim from verbosity or one easy fixture.
evidenceRequirements: Fresh sessions and known seeded issues; record actual findings.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “One Extra Skill” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: [SCOPE_LIMITED_CONCLUSION]. Would you build a small skill library?
instagramCaption: Same AI. One Extra Skill.. A/B review of the same diff with and without a focused review skill. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. [SCOPE_LIMITED_CONCLUSION]. Would you build a small skill library?
tiktokCaption: Same AI. One Extra Skill.. WOULD YOU SAVE THIS SKILL?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Diff, skill folder, both reviews, findings.
